from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialData(BaseModel):
    """Financial data for one company's 10-Q report for the period in question."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name as reported in the filing")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g., '2025-Q1' or 'March 31, 2025'")
    consolidated_net_income: float | None = Field(description="Consolidated net income for the period in millions of dollars")
    net_cash_from_financing_activities: float | None = Field(description="Net cash provided by/used in financing activities for the period in millions of dollars; negative indicates cash used")
    share_repurchases_amount: float | None = Field(description="Total share repurchases during the period in millions of dollars; $0 if none")
    weighted_average_basic_shares_current: float | None = Field(description="Weighted-average basic shares outstanding for current period in millions")
    weighted_average_basic_shares_prior: float | None = Field(description="Weighted-average basic shares outstanding for prior period in millions")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_financial_data: list[CompanyFinancialData]
